4624.title: Historical PR association survives new commits
4624.rootCauseOneLine: Branch-oriented gh pr view accepts terminal PRs without comparing them to the current commit; the server preserves that association and the merged state.
4624.proposedFix: Choose active-only versus terminal-history policy before filtering; commit-aware association may require a versioned host/server contract change. No safe autopilot PR.
4624.caveats: Exact Workspace path uses controlled external CLI output. Real CLI corroboration omits autoMergeRequest unsupported by installed gh 2.23.0. UI retains merged labeling; full browser reproduction was unavailable. Private reporter data was not accessed.
